name: Aquatic Wave-Swept Weapon

Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: +2 to attack and damage rolls; while held you breathe water and swim 30 feet, and it glows like a lantern.
text: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon. While you hold it you can breathe underwater and have a Swim Speed of 30 feet, and it sheds Bright Light in a 5-foot radius and Dim Light for 5 feet beyond. As a Magic action you can make up to a gallon of liquid it touches as salty as seawater.

powers.name: Salt Water

params.text: turns up to a gallon of touched water as briny as the sea

powers.text: Magic action: up to a gallon of liquid you touch with it turns salty. (No other effect in the game.)
